summary: A 1940 Aermotor tower above Ruidoso, NM, once a wildland lookout, now a town fire-watch post; a ranger's own memoir places him here watching the Trinity test.

facts.design: 30-ft Aermotor steel tower with 14x14 ft wood cab and steel mesh catwalk; reported as a rare MI-25 model in the Southwest

access.note: OpenStreetMap tags the structure access=no; no source found describing public visitation.

events.note: 30-ft Aermotor steel tower with 14x14 ft wood cab, per NHLR and the NRHP nomination; Living New Deal says the tower was 'most likely' a 1933 CCC project instead but defers to the nomination's 1940 date.
Added to the National Register of Historic Places January 27, 1988 (ref. 87002485); also entered on the New Mexico State Register of Cultural Properties March 4, 1988.

Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register November 26, 1996, nominated by David Johnson, Forest Archaeologist; register noted the tower was by then staffed by a town employee for urban/suburban fire detection rather than by the Forest Service.

sources.title: Ruidoso Lookout, Lincoln National Forest, NM
Tales of the Sierra Blanca: Stories of Long Ago
sources.publisher: Herbert Lee Traylor, Pioneer Publishing Company, 1983 (as cited by Wikipedia)

notes_for_editor: Build-year conflict: Living New Deal guesses a 1933 CCC origin but the NRHP nomination and NHLR both say 1940; the story follows 1940 and flags the disagreement rather than proposing a correction, since no source firmly contradicts the record. The Trinity-detonation anecdote rests solely on ranger Herbert Lee Traylor's own 1983 memoir, relayed by Wikipedia with no independent corroboration found; included but clearly flagged as single-source. Could not fetch the 2016 Ruidoso News NRHP article (fetch tool blocked ruidosonews.com) or an NRHP nomination PDF on npgallery.nps.gov; a human with better access to those could firm up the 1933-vs-1940 question and current staffing status. No corrections proposed to the tower record: name, location, height, agency and built year all match NHLR, Wikipedia and Wikidata.
